'''Lisaine Jarath''' is a ''[[der'sul'dam]]'' from [[Seandar]] in [[Seanchan]]. 

== Appearance ==
She has gray hair, a plump face and blue eyes.

== Activities ==
She rides under [[Kennar Miraj]] in the attack against [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces outside [[Ebou Dar]].
